description: Whole-turn evaluation: did a message in the language Account Managers actually use reach the right capability, and did the reply carry the right facts? Unlike evals/routing.json this does not assert an internal intent name — it asserts which lookups ran and what the user ends up reading, so the rules can be replaced by a planner without rewriting the cases. 'expect' capabilities must all be planned; 'forbid' must not be. Cases marked 'critical' are ones where a wrong answer misleads someone about safety or about money: any failure there fails the run.

billboards?

who looks after our instagram posts
can central marketing run our local radio ads
do you handle translating our web pages
cases.note: F1. Translation & localisation is Local; Web pages is Y. Two named candidates that disagree must produce a question, never a free-of-charge promise.
